operator: Empresa de Transportes Guanabara Ltda (STTU concession)
notes:
Built from Natal open-data (dados.natal.br) STTU/Guanabara sources: linhas.csv (line meta: travel time, extension, service period), horarios.csv (real per-trip terminal departure times for 19 lines), itinerarios.csv (ordered outbound/inbound street sequences per line), and per-line KML shapes from the CKAN package "rotas-guanabara" (real WGS-84 route geometry, correct for Natal ~-5.78,-35.25). WebFetch timed out on the slow dados.natal.br gateway; fetched all sources directly via curl (ISO-8859-1 decoded).

Feed scope: 19 lines that have PUBLISHED timetables in horarios.csv (4, 05/67, 10/29, 13, 15/16, 17/78, 19, 2, 20, 5, 593, 60, 64, 70, 72, 75, 79, 8, 81). The other ~19 lines in linhas.csv have no timetable and were excluded. All route_type=3 (city bus); no metro/rail exists for this operator (Natal's only rail is CBTU, a different operator).

Stops: the KML "Pontos" folder is a densified GPS trace (=LineString vertices), NOT discrete stops, and itinerarios lists turn-by-turn streets, so neither gives ready-made stops. Stops were generated by sampling each real KML route shape at ~900 m spacing (min 200 m apart), naming each from the ordered itinerarios street list mapped proportionally along the shape, with the named terminal at each end (e.g. line 4 terminal "Rua Arez" matches itinerarios "RUA AREZ (Terminal)"). Coordinates are therefore REAL (from official KML), names are real Natal street names in real route order, but exact stop placement/spacing is approximated (no official stop inventory was published). 719 stops total; stop_ids are per-shape-sample so a street can appear as several ids along a route.

Trips/times: outbound (direction 0) departures use the exact clock times from horarios.csv "saida do terminal"; direction alternates per successive departure (0,1,0,1...). Intermediate stop_times are interpolated evenly across each line's TempodeViagem (from linhas.csv) between the two terminals — real endpoints, even-headway interpolation between. 687 trips, 14147 stop_times, all monotonic; every route has both directions.

Calendar: 3 services (WEEKDAY / SATURDAY / SUNDAY) covering 2026. Note: all published trips were attached to WEEKDAY service (horarios.csv is the weekday "Util" schedule); Saturday/Sunday services are defined in calendar but Guanabara's Sat/Sun timetables were not in horarios.csv so no distinct weekend trips were fabricated. 

Confidence 0.62: real operator, real lines, real terminal departure times, real WGS-84 geometry and real street names in real order — but stop granularity/positions and intermediate timings are modeled (interpolated), and only the weekday timetable is represented. Full feed written to /home/ubuntu/adresses/natal_gtfs/gtfs/ and gtfs_guanabara_natal.zip. The structured payload below carries agency, all 19 routes, the 3 calendar services, a representative stop set, and full stop_times for two lines (R4 and R64) in both directions as exemplars; the complete 719-stop / 687-trip / 14147-stop_time tables are in the files on disk.
